description: The HEEW repository publishes code used to collect, clean and merge energy and weather observations for the companion Arizona dataset. Its public GitHub README names the Campus Metabolism Project and National Weather Service as inputs; the GitHub licence metadata identifies MIT for this software. It is a preparation workflow for the 147-building hourly HEEW release, not a building simulation engine. A modeller could use it to examine how missing values and abnormal observations became inputs for load calibration or capacity planning with model-energyplus. The article and Figshare metadata describe a two-stage cleaning method; this repository is the separate implementation address. A caveat is that the underlying source services and historical source revisions may change, so a rerun may not reproduce the archived CSVs byte for byte. I read repository metadata and README, but did not execute scripts, fetch upstream data, or compare regenerated output with the Figshare release. The output dataset has a separate CC BY 4.0 licence.
